observations: The page number «X» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it.
L30: «Contractus» is printed with the ct ligature of the type, c and t joined by an arc above; transcribed as two letters. L25: the r and v after the folio numbers are raised, recto and verso.
N07: «151– 152», a short dash followed by a space, where N01 and N03 print the long dash between the figures without a space («493—494», «109—110»); transcribed as printed.
Marks not transcribed: a dark speck above the hyphen of «kom-» (L31); mid-height specks between «de» and «France» (N03) and between «kleinere» and «Hälfte» (L36).
